models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Registered users of the Todo list application who can authenticate and manage their personal tasks.

Each user has a unique email address used for login purposes and a hashed password for secure authentication.
The user entity serves as the authentication principal and owner of tasks and sessions.

Users cannot be deleted outright; soft deletion is not implemented here. User lifecycle primarily includes creation, authentication, and potential deactivation handled outside this schema.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for user authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Plain passwords are never stored.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
Active sessions of the registered users representing authenticated login sessions.

This table stores session information including IP address, originating URL, and referrer URL to support auditing and session management.
Sessions have creation and optional expiration timestamps.

Each session is linked to a user, allowing multiple concurrent sessions per user.

This is a subsidiary table managed indirectly through user authentication and session handling flows.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session originated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL prior to accessing the session start URL.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp when the session expired.

models.name: todo_list_tasks
models.description:
Individual todo tasks managed privately by authenticated users.

This table stores all todo tasks created by users with strong ownership linkage via user ID. Each task has a unique identifier, title, optional description, timestamps for creation, update, completion, and soft deletion status. Tasks are always associated with exactly one user, ensuring data integrity and avoiding shared or public tasks.

The completion status is tracked as a boolean flag, and an optional completion timestamp records when the task was marked completed. Soft delete is enabled via nullable deleted_at field for task lifecycle management and audit.

User sessions and authentication details are handled exclusively in separate components to ensure modular design and single responsibility.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title. Must be a non-empty string with a maximum length of 255 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the task. Limited to 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the task has been completed (true) or is still pending (false).

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was marked completed. Null if task is incomplete.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last task update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null indicates the task is active.
